description: Gets the Trello list to which a specified card (which must exist) belongs.

inputSchema.description: Specifies the card and the desired list fields for retrieval.

fields.description: Fields of the list to return. Use 'all' for all fields, or a comma-separated list of specific field names (e.g., 'name,pos'). Allowed: 'closed', 'idBoard', 'name', 'pos', 'subscribed'.
fields.title: Fields

idCard.description: The card's unique ID (typically 24 characters) or its shortLink (e.g., 'AbCdEfGh' from the card URL).
idCard.title: Id Card

inputSchema.title: GetCardsListByIdCardRequest

name: get_cards_list_by_id_card

GetCardsListByIdCardResponse.description: Contains the details of the list to which the specified card belongs.

color.description: The color of the list (if set).
color.title: Color

id.description: The unique identifier of the list.
id.title: Id

idBoard.description: The unique identifier of the board containing this list.
idBoard.title: Id Board

idOrganization.description: The unique identifier of the organization containing this list's board.
idOrganization.title: Id Organization

nodeId.description: The Atlassian Resource Identifier (ARI) for this list.
nodeId.title: Node Id

pos.description: The position of the list on the board.
pos.title: Pos

softLimit.description: The soft limit for cards in this list (if set).
softLimit.title: Soft Limit

subscribed.description: Whether the current user is subscribed to the list.
subscribed.title: Subscribed

type.description: The type of the list (if applicable).
type.title: Type

GetCardsListByIdCardResponse.title: GetCardsListByIdCardResponse

ListLimitsCards.description: Limits for cards in a list.

openPerList.description: Limits for open cards per list.
openPerList.title: Open Per List

totalPerList.description: Limits for total cards per list.
totalPerList.title: Total Per List

ListLimitsCards.title: ListLimitsCards
